terms.label: actedOnBehalfOf
terms.definition: An object property to express the accountability of an agent towards another agent. The subordinate agent acted on behalf of the responsible agent in an actual activity.

terms.label: atLocation
terms.definition: The Location of any resource.

terms.label: atTime
terms.definition: The time at which an InstantaneousEvent occurred, in the form of xsd:dateTime.

Classify prov-o terms into three categories, including 'starting-point', 'qualifed', and 'extended'. This classification is used by the prov-o html document to gently introduce prov-o terms to its users.

Classify prov-o terms into six components according to prov-dm, including 'agents-responsibility', 'alternate', 'annotations', 'collections', 'derivations', and 'entities-activities'. This classification is used so that readers of prov-o specification can find its correspondence with the prov-dm specification.
A reference to the principal section of the PROV-CONSTRAINTS document that describes this concept.
A definition quoted from PROV-DM or PROV-CONSTRAINTS that describes the concept expressed with this OWL term.
A reference to the principal section of the PROV-DM document that describes this concept.
A note by the OWL development team about how this term expresses the PROV-DM concept, or how it should be used in context of semantic web or linked data.
When the prov-o term does not have a definition drawn from prov-dm, and the prov-o editor provides one.

terms.label: endedAtTime
terms.definition: The time at which an activity ended. See also prov:startedAtTime.

terms.label: generatedAtTime
terms.definition: The time at which an entity was completely created and is available for use.

terms.label: hadActivity
terms.definition: The _optional_ Activity of an Influence, which used, generated, invalidated, or was the responsibility of some Entity. This property is _not_ used by ActivityInfluence (use prov:activity instead).

terms.label: hadGeneration
terms.definition: The _optional_ Generation involved in an Entity's Derivation.

terms.label: hadPlan
terms.definition: The _optional_ Plan adopted by an Agent in Association with some Activity. Plan specifications are out of the scope of this specification.

terms.label: hadRole
terms.definition: The _optional_ Role that an Entity assumed in the context of an Activity. For example, :baking prov:used :spoon; prov:qualified [ a prov:Usage; prov:entity :spoon; prov:hadRole roles:mixing_implement ].

terms.label: hadUsage
terms.definition: The _optional_ Usage involved in an Entity's Derivation.

terms.label: influencer
terms.definition: Subproperties of prov:influencer are used to cite the object of an unqualified PROV-O triple whose predicate is a subproperty of prov:wasInfluencedBy (e.g. prov:used, prov:wasGeneratedBy). prov:influencer is used much like rdf:object is used.

terms.label: invalidatedAtTime
terms.definition: The time at which an entity was invalidated (i.e., no longer usable).

PROV-O does not define all property inverses. The directionalities defined in PROV-O should be given preference over those not defined. However, if users wish to name the inverse of a PROV-O property, the local name given by prov:inverse should be used.
A reference to the principal section of the PROV-DM document that describes this concept.

The position that this OWL term should be listed within documentation. The scope of the documentation (e.g., among all terms, among terms within a prov:category, among properties applying to a particular class, etc.) is unspecified.

terms.label: qualifiedAssociation
terms.definition: If this Activity prov:wasAssociatedWith Agent :ag, then it can qualify the Association using prov:qualifiedAssociation [ a prov:Association; prov:agent :ag; :foo :bar ].

terms.label: qualifiedAttribution
terms.definition: If this Entity prov:wasAttributedTo Agent :ag, then it can qualify how it was influenced using prov:qualifiedAttribution [ a prov:Attribution; prov:agent :ag; :foo :bar ].

terms.label: qualifiedCommunication
terms.definition: If this Activity prov:wasInformedBy Activity :a, then it can qualify how it was influenced using prov:qualifiedCommunication [ a prov:Communication; prov:activity :a; :foo :bar ].

terms.label: qualifiedDelegation
terms.definition: If this Agent prov:actedOnBehalfOf Agent :ag, then it can qualify how with prov:qualifiedResponsibility [ a prov:Responsibility; prov:agent :ag; :foo :bar ].

terms.label: qualifiedDerivation
terms.definition: If this Entity prov:wasDerivedFrom Entity :e, then it can qualify how it was derived using prov:qualifiedDerivation [ a prov:Derivation; prov:entity :e; :foo :bar ].

terms.label: qualifiedEnd
terms.definition: If this Activity prov:wasEndedBy Entity :e1, then it can qualify how it was ended using prov:qualifiedEnd [ a prov:End; prov:entity :e1; :foo :bar ].

This annotation property links a subproperty of prov:wasInfluencedBy with the subclass of prov:Influence and the qualifying property that are used to qualify it. Example annotation: prov:wasGeneratedBy prov:qualifiedForm prov:qualifiedGeneration, prov:Generation . Then this unqualified assertion: :entity1 prov:wasGeneratedBy :activity1 . can be qualified by adding: :entity1 prov:qualifiedGeneration :entity1Gen . :entity1Gen a prov:Generation, prov:Influence; prov:activity :activity1; :customValue 1337 . Note how the value of the unqualified influence (prov:wasGeneratedBy :activity1) is mirrored as the value of the prov:activity (or prov:entity, or prov:agent) property on the influence class.

terms.label: qualifiedGeneration
terms.definition: If this Activity prov:generated Entity :e, then it can qualify how it performed the Generation using prov:qualifiedGeneration [ a prov:Generation; prov:entity :e; :foo :bar ].

terms.label: qualifiedInfluence
terms.definition: Because prov:qualifiedInfluence is a broad relation, the more specific relations (qualifiedCommunication, qualifiedDelegation, qualifiedEnd, etc.) should be used when applicable.

terms.label: qualifiedInvalidation
terms.definition: If this Entity prov:wasInvalidatedBy Activity :a, then it can qualify how it was invalidated using prov:qualifiedInvalidation [ a prov:Invalidation; prov:activity :a; :foo :bar ].

terms.label: qualifiedPrimarySource
terms.definition: If this Entity prov:hadPrimarySource Entity :e, then it can qualify how using prov:qualifiedPrimarySource [ a prov:PrimarySource; prov:entity :e; :foo :bar ].

terms.label: qualifiedQuotation
terms.definition: If this Entity prov:wasQuotedFrom Entity :e, then it can qualify how using prov:qualifiedQuotation [ a prov:Quotation; prov:entity :e; :foo :bar ].

terms.label: qualifiedRevision
terms.definition: If this Entity prov:wasRevisionOf Entity :e, then it can qualify how it was revised using prov:qualifiedRevision [ a prov:Revision; prov:entity :e; :foo :bar ].

terms.label: qualifiedStart
terms.definition: If this Activity prov:wasStartedBy Entity :e1, then it can qualify how it was started using prov:qualifiedStart [ a prov:Start; prov:entity :e1; :foo :bar ].

terms.label: qualifiedUsage
terms.definition: If this Activity prov:used Entity :e, then it can qualify how it used it using prov:qualifiedUsage [ a prov:Usage; prov:entity :e; :foo :bar ].

terms.label: startedAtTime
terms.definition: The time at which an activity started. See also prov:endedAtTime.
Classes and properties used to qualify relationships are annotated with prov:unqualifiedForm to indicate the property used to assert an unqualified provenance relation.

terms.label: used
terms.definition: A prov:Entity that was used by this prov:Activity. For example, :baking prov:used :spoon, :egg, :oven .

terms.label: wasAssociatedWith
terms.definition: An prov:Agent that had some (unspecified) responsibility for the occurrence of this prov:Activity.

terms.label: wasAttributedTo
terms.definition: Attribution is the ascribing of an entity to an agent.

terms.label: wasDerivedFrom
terms.definition: The more specific subproperties of prov:wasDerivedFrom (i.e., prov:wasQuotedFrom, prov:wasRevisionOf, prov:hadPrimarySource) should be used when applicable.

terms.label: wasEndedBy
terms.definition: End is when an activity is deemed to have ended. An end may refer to an entity, known as trigger, that terminated the activity.

terms.label: wasInfluencedBy
terms.definition: Because prov:wasInfluencedBy is a broad relation, its more specific subproperties (e.g. prov:wasInformedBy, prov:actedOnBehalfOf, prov:wasEndedBy, etc.) should be used when applicable.

terms.label: wasInformedBy
terms.definition: An activity a2 is dependent on or informed by another activity a1, by way of some unspecified entity that is generated by a1 and used by a2.

terms.label: wasQuotedFrom
terms.definition: An entity is derived from an original entity by copying, or 'quoting', some or all of it.

terms.label: wasRevisionOf
terms.definition: A revision is a derivation that revises an entity into a revised version.

terms.label: wasStartedBy
terms.definition: Start is when an activity is deemed to have started. A start may refer to an entity, known as trigger, that initiated the activity.
